text:
ada: hey everyone, ada joining infra today. quick orientation Qs: who maintains the "owner map" for services (teams + escalation contacts)? i want to bookmark it. also i'm blocked getting Vault tokens and the infra confluence space says restricted. who do i ping for access and for emergency escalation if i hit a prod alert before i'm fully onboarded?

luis (eng-platform): welcome ada! :wave: owner map is in Confluence under Team Directory -> Service Owners (https://redwood.internal/confluence/team-directory). people-ops keeps the HR side updated, and eng-platform owns the infra-owner canonical copy for deployment/ownership metadata. luis: @ada, i'll add you to the Confluence group and ping infra-owners channel so you can see the doc.

people-ops: @ada hi! i'll add the Confluence access in your onboarding checklist and request a Vault role grant for the temp token. can you DM me your preferred email and phone? also badge requests: facilities@redwood.com — cc me.

ada: thanks! for Vault, i ran `vault login -method=oidc` and got "permission denied: not authorized".

security: @ada that's expected until we grant the infra-read role. send your employee email to people-ops and we'll trigger the approval. note: for secrets write access you need manager signoff + security ack.

luis (eng-platform): short note on escalation: for production alerts, page `sre-oncall` first. If you're not yet on PagerDuty, raise an "urgent: coverage" in #eng-oncall and someone will take over. If SRE doesn't ack in ~10 minutes, escalate to the EM oncall (listed in the owner map next to each service).

sre-oncall: confirmed. to get temporary coverage, post in #eng-oncall with the subject line: "coverage request - <service> - <short desc>". include your contact and whether you can join console. we'll add context and take ownership.

emily (eng-manager): adding: your manager (me) is the fallback contact for untriaged alerts for our squad. if SRE can't be reached and it's >15m, escalate to me directly and i'll coordinate cross-team.

devex-bot: Access request submitted: REQUEST-20260324-82. Targets: Confluence (infra-space), Vault (infra-read). ETA 1 business day.

ada: great — one last thing: where's the "who-to-ask" for hardware access and GPU reservations?

luis (eng-platform): GPU reservations handled by eng-infra reservations page (https://redwood.internal/tools/gpu-reservations). hardware/security access requests are via facilities@redwood.com and security@redwood.com for keys/cards. i'll add links to the owner map in Confluence.

people-ops: ping me if badge or building access stalls — i'll escalate to facilities manager.

ada: perfect, thanks all. filing a follow-up ticket in the onboarding checklist now :+1:

luis (eng-platform): one more tip: bookmark the owner map and add the oncall PD schedules to your calendar (links in the Confluence page). helps a lot the first week.
